title: P3HCL 综合练习 34
note: 口试练习（第11-12页）在口试应用里。听写词语（第13页）在“最新词语”第95组。

sections.title: 一、语文应用
sections.instruction: 从各题所提供的四个选项中，选出正确的答案。

questions.text: 我____妈妈星期天带我去附近的公园游玩。
questions.why: “请求”是有礼貌地要求别人做一件事。我请求妈妈带我去公园。回答＝answer，叫喊＝shout，原谅＝forgive，都和句子的意思不合。
questions.en: I asked (requested) Mum to take me to the nearby park on Sunday.

questions.text: 同学们都认真完成老师给的____。
questions.why: “完成任务”是固定搭配。老师给同学的是“任务”（task）。路线＝route，安排＝arrangement。
questions.en: The students all completed the task given by the teacher seriously.

questions.text: 过了几天，绿豆有了一些____。
questions.why: “有了一些变化”——“变化”是名词（change）。“变成／变为”后面要接“变成什么”，“变形”是变了形状，这里都不合。
questions.en: After a few days, the green beans showed some changes.

questions.text: 我们____先把绳子穿过去，才能打结。
questions.why: “需要先……才能……”＝必须先做一件事，才可以做另一件事。“一定”要说“一定要”才通。
questions.en: We need to pass the rope through first before we can tie a knot.

questions.text: 哥哥为了准备考试，____很久没有玩游戏机了。
questions.why: “已经很久没有……了”＝has not … for a long time already。“已经”和句尾的“了”是一对。
questions.en: To prepare for the exam, my brother has already not played video games for a long time.

questions.text: 电梯早上还是好好的，现在____坏了？
questions.why: “怎么坏了？”＝How come it's broken? 用“怎么”问原因，带着奇怪的语气。
questions.en: The lift was fine this morning. How come it's broken now?

questions.text: 小文的爸爸____我的爸爸，因为他们是小学同学。
questions.why: 认识一个人用“认识”（know a person）。“知道”是知道一件事（know a fact）。他们是同学，所以互相“认识”。
questions.en: Xiaowen's father knows my father, because they were primary school classmates.

questions.text: 为了____当画家的愿望，哥哥每天都很用心地画画。
questions.why: “实现愿望”＝make a wish come true，是固定搭配。“成为画家”可以说，但“成为……的愿望”说不通。
questions.en: In order to realise his wish of becoming a painter, my brother paints attentively every day.

questions.text: 乱丢垃圾会____环境。
questions.why: 乱丢垃圾是坏事，会“破坏环境”（damage the environment）。“保护”是相反的意思。
questions.en: Littering damages the environment.

questions.text: 康康生病了，小安____他去比赛。
questions.why: “代替他去比赛”＝go to the competition in his place。康康不能去，小安替他去。
questions.en: Kangkang is sick, so Xiao'an took his place in the competition.

questions.text: 想到被人发现了，小偷吓得直____。
questions.why: “吓得直发抖”＝so scared that he kept trembling。“直”＋动作＝一直做。“发软”一般说“腿发软”。
questions.en: Thinking he had been discovered, the thief trembled with fright.

questions.text: 小华没想到能得第一，她____地叫了出来。
questions.why: 得了第一名，心情很“兴奋”（excited），所以“兴奋地叫了出来”。
questions.en: Xiaohua didn't expect to come first. She cried out excitedly.

questions.text: ____今天天气不好，____飞机明天起飞。
questions.why: 天气不好是原因，飞机明天才起飞是结果。原因＋结果＝“因为……所以……”。
questions.en: Because the weather is bad today, the plane will take off tomorrow.

questions.text: 放学时，我们____把教室的门窗关好。
questions.why: 这是应该做的事，用“应该”（should）。“准备”是 prepare，意思不对。
questions.en: When school ends, we should close the classroom doors and windows properly.

questions.text: 妹妹不会写“鸡蛋”这两个字，只好用图画来____。
questions.why: 不会写字，就用图画“代替”字（use a picture instead）。“代表”是 represent，比如“国旗代表国家”。
questions.en: My sister can't write the words “egg”, so she had to use a drawing instead.

questions.text: 我们先进行小组____，然后回家各自准备。
questions.why: “小组讨论”＝group discussion，是学校常用的词。“吵架”是 quarrel，小组不会先吵架！
questions.en: We first had a group discussion, then went home to prepare on our own.

questions.text: 每天傍晚，我们一家人都会去公园____。
questions.why: 去公园“散步”＝take a walk。“走路”只是用脚走，不是去公园做的活动。
questions.en: Every evening, our family goes to the park for a walk.

questions.text: 这张桌子很重，要两个人才能____。
questions.why: 搬桌子用“搬动”（carry / move a heavy thing）。“举起”是举高，“移动”太一般。
questions.en: This table is very heavy. It takes two people to move it.

questions.text: 你____看这朵花，再把它画下来。
questions.why: 画画之前要“仔细看”（look carefully）。
questions.en: Look at this flower carefully, then draw it.

questions.text: 小文说得对，钱包____是被小明拿走的。
questions.why: “果然”＝as expected。小文早就说是小明拿的，结果真的是——就用“果然”。“从来”要和“不／没”一起用（从来没有）。
questions.en: Xiaowen was right. Sure enough, the wallet was taken by Xiaoming.

questions.text: 我____妈妈带我去动物园，妈妈同意了。
questions.why: 我“请求”妈妈（ask politely），妈妈才“同意”。“讨论”要说“和妈妈讨论”。“求救”是叫救命。
questions.en: I asked Mum to take me to the zoo, and Mum agreed.

questions.text: 下午，小安和婆婆在购物中心____了林老师。
questions.why: 在购物中心“碰到”＝bump into（没约好，刚好遇见）。打招呼要说“向林老师打招呼”。
questions.en: In the afternoon, Xiao'an and Grandma bumped into Teacher Lin at the shopping centre.

questions.text: 妈妈把脏衣服____干净。
questions.why: 衣服要“清洗”（wash）。“收拾／整理”是把东西弄整齐，“打扫”是扫地。记住：洗衣服＝清洗，收拾房间＝收拾。
questions.en: Mum washed the dirty clothes clean.

questions.text: 小马住在小象家____，它常常去找小象玩。
questions.why: 住在小象家“附近”＝lives near。因为住得近，所以常常去玩。“外面”是 outside，住在别人家外面很奇怪。
questions.en: Little Horse lives near Little Elephant's home, so it often goes to play with Little Elephant.

questions.text: 我们不可以乱丢垃圾，要保护____。
questions.why: “保护环境”（protect the environment）是固定搭配。
questions.en: We must not litter. We must protect the environment.

questions.text: ____手机上地图，我找到了欢欢的家。
questions.why: “按照地图”＝according to the map。“沿着”是 along，后面接路、河、海边（沿着马路走）。
questions.en: Following the map on my phone, I found Huanhuan's home.

questions.text: 哥哥起晚了，____和我们一起吃早餐就上学去了。
questions.why: 起晚了，没有时间吃早餐＝“来不及”（no time to）。“忍不住”是 can't help doing，“受不了”是 can't stand。
questions.en: My brother woke up late and went to school without having time to eat breakfast with us.

questions.text: 弟弟努力学习，____以后能成为一名老师。
questions.why: “希望以后能……”＝hope to … in future。
questions.en: My brother studies hard, hoping to become a teacher in the future.

questions.text: 哥哥很____，什么数学题都难不倒他。
questions.why: “什么题都难不倒他”说的是他的能力，所以是“聪明”（clever）。专心／用功／认真是态度。
questions.en: My brother is very clever. No maths question can stump him.

questions.text: 妹妹一个人搬不动这张桌子，____我们帮忙。
questions.why: 搬不动，就“需要我们帮忙”（needs our help）。
questions.en: My sister can't move this table alone. She needs our help.

sections.title: 二、词语搭配
sections.instruction: 根据意思选词语。每组有两个词语用不到。

questions.why: 把水“倒进杯子”。
questions.en: pour into the cup

questions.why: “庆祝节日”＝celebrate a festival。
questions.en: celebrate a festival

questions.why: “贴在墙上”＝stick on the wall。“弄到墙上”意思不清楚。
questions.en: stick on the wall

questions.why: “弄脏裙子”＝dirty the skirt。
questions.en: dirty the skirt

questions.why: “认识朋友”＝make friends。
questions.en: get to know friends

questions.why: “转身离开”＝turn around and leave（讲义第14号词）。
questions.en: turn around and leave

questions.why: “翻开课本”＝open the textbook（动词搭配）。“一本课本”语法也通，老师可能也接受。
questions.en: open the textbook

questions.why: “掉进坑里”＝fall into a hole。
questions.en: fall into the hole

questions.why: “爬上山坡”＝climb up the slope。
questions.en: climb up the slope

questions.why: “讨论问题”＝discuss a question。
questions.en: discuss a problem

questions.why: “跌倒受伤”＝fall and get hurt。
questions.en: fall down and get injured

questions.why: “摆动身体”＝sway the body。
questions.en: sway the body

questions.why: “懂事能干”＝sensible and capable，常一起用来夸孩子。
questions.en: sensible and capable

questions.why: “打开盖子”＝open the lid。
questions.en: open the lid

questions.why: “准时下课”＝end class on time。
questions.en: end class on time

questions.why: “实现愿望”＝realise a wish（和第8题一样！）。
questions.en: realise a wish

questions.why: “称出重量”＝weigh out the weight。称＝weigh。
questions.en: weigh out the weight

questions.why: “废物利用”＝make use of waste（识读字词第4号）。
questions.en: recycle waste

sections.title: 三、短文填空
sections.instruction: 从所提供的词语中，选出短文中所缺的词语。

passage: 【49】醋的味道怪怪的，但是它的用处可真不少。
洗澡时，在水里加一点醋，不但可以消除疲劳，减少肥皂对皮肤的【50】，还能使皮肤变得更光滑。
用醋来洗头，还能使头发变得更加乌黑柔软。吃【51】时加一点醋，可以除去海鲜的异味。
听说醋还可以用来清洁【52】的厕所，保持环境的干净。
醋的好处还有很多，家里最好【53】一瓶醋，以备急用。

questions.text: ____醋的味道怪怪的，但是它的用处可真不少。
questions.why: 看到后面的“但是”，前面就要用“虽然”。虽然……但是……是一对。
questions.en: Although vinegar tastes strange, it has many uses.

questions.text: 减少肥皂对皮肤的____
questions.why: 肥皂对皮肤不好，醋可以“减少破坏”（reduce the damage）。“保护”是好的东西，不用减少。
questions.en: reduce the damage soap does to the skin

questions.text: 吃____时加一点醋，可以除去海鲜的异味。
questions.why: 后面说“海鲜”（seafood），所以是吃“鱼虾”。
questions.en: Adding a little vinegar when eating fish and prawns removes the fishy smell.

questions.text: 清洁____的厕所
questions.why: 要清洁的当然是“肮脏的厕所”（dirty toilet）。
questions.en: clean a dirty toilet

questions.text: 家里最好____一瓶醋，以备急用。
questions.why: “准备一瓶醋”＝keep a bottle ready。“以备急用”＝in case of need。
questions.en: It's best to keep a bottle of vinegar at home in case it's needed.

sections.title: 四、完成句子
sections.instruction: 从表中选出适当的短句。每组有一句用不到。

groups.label: A组
bank: 水池里虽然有很多小鱼
我的拖鞋被小狗咬破了

questions.text: 看到一辆车向他冲过来，____。
questions.why: 车冲过来 → 很害怕 → “吓得全身发抖”。
questions.en: Seeing a car rushing towards him, he trembled all over with fright.

questions.text: ____，所以今天没有去上学。
questions.why: 后面有“所以”，前面就找“因为……”。
questions.en: Because my brother is sick, he didn't go to school today.

questions.text: 乌龟慢慢爬上了山顶，____。
questions.why: 爬上山顶以后，就能“看到美丽的风景”。
questions.en: The tortoise slowly climbed to the top of the hill and saw the beautiful scenery.

questions.text: ____，我不能穿着出门了。
questions.why: 不能穿了 → 因为“拖鞋被小狗咬破了”。
questions.en: My slippers were bitten through by the puppy, so I can't wear them out.

questions.text: ____，但是我一条也抓不到。
questions.why: 后面有“但是”，前面找“虽然……”。“一条”是鱼的量词，所以是小鱼。
questions.en: Although there are many little fish in the pond, I can't catch a single one.

groups.label: B组
bank: 蜜蜂在花丛中飞来飞去

questions.text: 你这样乱扔垃圾，____。
questions.why: 乱扔垃圾的结果：“会引来不少蚊虫”（识读字词第10号：引来蚊虫）。
questions.en: If you litter like this, you will attract lots of mosquitoes and insects.

questions.text: ____，但是他十分热爱学习。
questions.why: “但是”前面配“虽然”。贪玩和热爱学习是相反的。
questions.en: Although my brother loves to play, he loves studying very much.

questions.text: ____，忙着采蜜。
questions.why: 采蜜的是蜜蜂。
questions.en: The bees fly around among the flowers, busy collecting nectar.

questions.text: 大热天跑步，____。
questions.why: 大热天跑步 → “大家都流了一身汗”。
questions.en: Running on a hot day, everyone was covered in sweat.

questions.text: 今天天气真好，____！
questions.why: 天气好 → 提议“我们去公园散步吧！”。“吧”和“！”都表示提议。
questions.en: The weather is so nice today. Let's go for a walk in the park!

sections.title: 五、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 根据短文的内容和上下文的意思，选出最正确的一个答案。

groups.label: A组 · 通告
passage: 为了让同学们更好地了解有关胡姬花的科学知识，我们将在明天（11月20日）下午带同学们到胡姬花园去参观。
学生自备物品：食用水、点心
如果有事不能参加，请向级任老师请假。
groups.passageEn: To all Primary 3 pupils: So that pupils can better understand the science of orchids, we will take pupils to visit the Orchid Garden tomorrow afternoon (20 Nov). Meeting point: school hall. Departure: 2 pm. Bring your own drinking water and snacks. If you cannot attend, ask your form teacher for leave. Qingqing Primary School, 19 Nov 2025.

questions.text: 这则通告的主要内容是什么？
options: 通知学生上科学课的时间、地点和日期。
通知全校学生要带食用水和点心来上学。
通知三年级的学生去参观胡姬花园的事。
通知学生以后有事可以向级任老师请假。
questions.why: 通告一开头就写“所有三年级的同学”，整篇讲的是去参观胡姬花园。其他三项只是小细节，不是主要内容。
questions.en: The main point: informing P3 pupils about the Orchid Garden visit.

questions.text: 学校为什么要带同学们去参观胡姬花园？
options: 为了让同学们放轻松好好玩一玩。
为了让同学们学会整理所需物品。
为了让同学们更好地了解胡姬花。
为了让同学们多学一些科学知识。
questions.why: 短文说“为了让同学们更好地了解有关胡姬花的科学知识”——重点是了解胡姬花。第4项太笼统。
questions.en: So that pupils can understand orchids better.

questions.text: 这则通告是在什么时候发出的？
questions.why: 看通告最下面的日期：2025年11月19日。11月20日是“明天”参观的日子。
questions.en: The notice is dated 19 November.

questions.text: 关于本文，以下哪一个说法是不对的？
options: 学校没有为学生准备食用水和点心。
三年级的学生在明天下午两点出发。
三年级的学生必须去胡姬花园参观。
三年级的学生明天下午在礼堂集合。
questions.why: 通告说“如果有事不能参加，请向级任老师请假”，所以不是“必须”去。其他三项通告里都有写。注意题目问的是“不对的”！
questions.en: Wrong statement: pupils MUST go. In fact, they may ask for leave.

groups.label: B组 · 广告
passage: 欢迎大家去富士山游玩
天天旅行社将推出“五天日本富士山”旅游配套。这个配套将让您体验到日本富士山冬天的雪景和山上清新的空气。整个配套只需 $1099。
除了欣赏富士山的景色之外，您还有机会尝试滑雪。
groups.passageEn: Welcome to Mount Fuji! Tiantian Travel Agency is launching a 5-day Mount Fuji package. You will experience Mount Fuji's winter snow scenery and the fresh mountain air, all for only $1099. Besides enjoying the scenery, you will also have the chance to try skiing.

questions.text: 这个旅游主要让你观看什么？
questions.why: “观看”是用眼睛看。能看的是“雪景”（snow scenery）。空气不能看，冬天是季节。
questions.en: The trip mainly lets you see Japan's snow scenery.

questions.text: 除了欣赏风景，旅客还有机会尝试哪些活动？
questions.why: 最后一句：“还有机会尝试滑雪”。滑雪（ski）不是滑冰（skate）！
questions.en: Besides the scenery, visitors can try skiing.

sections.title: 课后练习 · 扩写句子
sections.instruction: 根据学过的“句子变变变”，完成下列句子。这是本周的课后作业（第10页）。

items.answer: 弟弟虽然长得很矮小，但是他可以跳得很高。
items.why: 两句意思相反（矮小 ↔ 跳得高），用“虽然……但是……”连起来。“虽然”放在“弟弟”后面或前面都可以；第二句用“他”代替“弟弟”，不要重复。
items.en: Although my brother is short, he can jump very high.

items.answer: 妹妹不但参加了游泳比赛，还参加了跑步比赛。
items.why: 两句是同一个人做的两件事，一件加一件，用“不但……还……”。“不但”放在主语“妹妹”后面。
items.en: My sister not only took part in the swimming race, but also the running race.

original: 黄老师教我华文后，我就越来越喜欢华文了。
items.answer: 自从黄老师教我华文后，我就越来越喜欢华文了。
items.why: “自从……后／以来”＝since (a time in the past)。“自从”放在句子最前面，后面常有“就”。
items.en: Ever since Teacher Huang started teaching me Chinese, I have liked Chinese more and more.

original: 小安做完了自己的功课。
小安帮妈妈收拾了房间。
items.answer: 小安不但做完了自己的功课，还帮妈妈收拾了房间。
items.why: 和第2题一样：同一个人做了两件好事，用“不但……还……”。第二句把“小安”去掉。
items.en: Xiao'an not only finished her own homework, but also helped Mum tidy the room.

original: 弟弟的听写得了一百分，他又叫又跳。
items.answer: 弟弟的听写得了一百分，他高兴得又叫又跳。
items.why: “高兴得＋动作”说明高兴到什么程度（so happy that…）。这里的“得”读 de，前面是心情，后面是动作。
items.en: My brother scored full marks for his spelling test. He was so happy that he shouted and jumped.

sections.title: 本周作业 · 复习口试（熟读三次）
sections.instruction: 第四项作业：复习之前学过的口试，每篇读三次。“我认为……因为……”是看图说话的万能句式。

sentences.zh: 我认为小男孩这种乐于助人的行为是值得我们学习和称赞的。
sentences.en: I think the little boy's helpful behaviour is worth learning from and praising.

sentences.zh: 因为俗话说：“助人为快乐之本”。
sentences.en: Because as the saying goes, “helping others is the root of happiness”.

sentences.zh: 我们应该在别人需要帮助时，主动伸出援助之手。
sentences.en: When others need help, we should take the initiative to lend a helping hand.

vocab.py: zhù rén wéi kuài lè zhī běn
vocab.en: helping others is the root of happiness

vocab.py: shēn chū yuán zhù zhī shǒu

sentences.zh: 我认为女生的行为是诚实的，是值得我们学习和称赞的。
sentences.en: I think the girl's behaviour is honest and worth learning from and praising.

sentences.zh: 因为诚实是一种美德，我们在捡到东西后应该物归原主，不应该占为己有，做一个诚实的人。
sentences.en: Because honesty is a virtue. When we pick something up, we should return it to its owner, not keep it for ourselves, and be an honest person.

vocab.en: return a thing to its owner

sentences.zh: 我认为哥哥和弟弟帮父母做家务是值得我们学习和称赞的。
sentences.en: I think the brothers helping their parents with housework is worth learning from and praising.

sentences.zh: 因为父母平时工作很忙，我们应该主动帮父母做一些家务，不让他们那么辛苦。
sentences.en: Because our parents are busy with work, we should take the initiative to do some housework so they are not so tired.

sentences.zh: 我认为插队是一种自私的行为。
sentences.en: I think cutting the queue is a selfish behaviour.

sentences.zh: 因为她不应该只想到自己，而不考虑别人的感受。
sentences.en: Because she should not think only of herself without considering other people's feelings.
